caption: Repeats a symbol ten times
A list of ten ones, handy as a weight vector
A symbolic length makes the repeat empty, so the dot stays unevaluated with an empty list

wolfram.note: Wolfram's Dimensions reads an unevaluated call as an array of its arguments, so Dimensions[ConstantArray[c, dims]] is {2}; ours takes it as a scalar with an empty shape.
